programme.desc: He was a gifted footballer, calm as a trainer and always inimitable: Willem van Hanegem. Embraced by football-loving Netherlands, praised in Rotterdam, the city of 'his' Feyenoord. programme.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
programme.desc: Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, with the internet still in its infancy, it was only belatedly realized in Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. A VHS tape of Messi's highlights was made and delivered to the Argentina association to make him an Argentina international. – Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Kazimierz Kmiecik is a legend of Wisła Kraków. He was associated with it both as a player and as a coach. To this day, he is the best scorer in the history of the White Star. He scored 153 goals in 304 matches played. The hero of the first episode is Jesus Imaz, who, after nine years of playing in Poland, has a chance to go down in history as the most effective foreign player in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa. The Jagiellonia Białystok player is fighting to break the record held by Flavio Paixao. The creators show the behind-the-scenes of his sports competition, as well as the private life of the Spaniard who, together with his family, became associated with Poland. They also visit Catalonia, where his football career began. Poland. 2026. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Winning Time: Reggie Miller vs. The New York Knicks
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Told by spies themselves from inside the intelligence community, each story keeps viewers on the edge of their seats, immersing them in never-before-seen adventures. From the real-life Jason Bourne to the covert missions to kill Osama bin Laden and minute-by-minute depictions of how to get behind enemy lines, each episode brings viewers as close to the world of espionage as possible. With unprecedented access to the world's most elite intelligence officers and their missions, you'll discover the varied, dedicated, and often deadly work of the world's most effective spy agency. USA

programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep1 «Secret Life of the Kangaroo»…The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of foodInstinctively associated with Australia, the kangaroo is an animal unlike any other. The hopping marsupial is certainly Australia's most famous creature, and this documentary series explores the eastern grey kangaroos of Queensland and Victoria. Journeying into Queensland's Sundown National Park and Victoria's coastal resort of Anglesea, the series reveals the social intricacies of these unique creatures, showcasing their surprising mob-like mentality, breeding practices, and ways of life. programme.title: Brazil Untamed: Cat Country (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2015. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep5 «Brazil Untamed»…In many countries the vulnerable and elusive ocelot is on the Endangered Species List. But on the southern edge of the Pantanal, one of the world's largest tropical wetlands, this magnificent wild cat seems to be making a comeback. A team of young wildlife scientists is trying to understand whyThe mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birdsDirector: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: Leopards in Mumbai, hyenas in Harar, peregrine falcons in New York, flocks of starlings in Rome: The final part of the “Terra X” series about extreme habitats shows how wild animals have adapted to cities. The cheekiest inhabitants are probably rhesus monkeys, which dominate entire neighborhoods in Jaipur.

programme.title: Blue Wonder Pacific
programme.desc:
At 166 million square kilometers, the Pacific Ocean is larger than all of our planet's land areas combined. And it encompasses habitats that could hardly be more contrasting: the fantastic gardens of tropical coral reefs, the endless water desert of the open sea, the dense kelp forests off the coast of America. 

In two parts, “Terra X” portrays inhabitants of these worlds – the blue whale, for example. The probably largest animal that has ever lived in the world feeds on tiny creatures: it scoops up to forty million small crustaceans out of the water every day with its baleen. The sea otters off Big Sur are also food specialists. They specialize in sea urchins and prevent the spiny creatures from eating the seabed bare. 

Meanwhile, a heartbreaking drama is unfolding on the beaches of Costa Rica: When the olive ridley sea turtles hatch in September, hungry birds of prey and dogs are already waiting...

programme.title: Wild home – this is how the animal kingdom lives

programme.desc: Latest findings about sexuality in the animal world: Researchers have investigated the question of whether there is gender-specific behavior in animals and made astonishing observations. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: How do tiny animals survive in a world of giants? Insects – the most diverse group of animals – conquer almost every habitat with amazing strength, endurance and agility. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Intelligent and colorful: squid, squid, cuttlefish and nautiluses are among the most mysterious sea creatures. A glimpse into the world of molluscs with arms and tentacles. (Station info).

programme.title: Fragile beauty of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The Strait of Messina separates the southern tip of Italy from Sicily and is rich in biodiversity. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: An intensive nature trip full of risks: adventurer Steve Backshall penetrates the world of the caimans and follows the trail of the mighty giant otter. (Station info).

programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: Steve Backshall travels to a place where hardly anyone goes: Brazil's Queimada Grande, the infamous Snake Island - an extreme expedition that pushes the adventurer to his limits. (Station info).

programme.title: The queens of the savannah
programme.desc: When it comes to emancipation, they are at the forefront: elephant cows lead the herd, lionesses are much more combative than their male counterparts, and female baboons team up to raise their babies and teach them social behavior.

programme.title: The Ocelot – A Cat in Distress
programme.desc: The ocelot is found in fewer than 80 species in the United States, making it one of the most endangered wild cats in the country. Wildlife filmmaker Ben Masters gets unexpectedly close to a mother ocelot and her young. (Station info).

programme.title: Queer Planet
programme.desc: Latest findings about sexuality in the animal world: Researchers have investigated the question of whether there is gender-specific behavior in animals and made astonishing observations. (Station info).

programme.title: Lobster – Fighter of the Deep
programme.desc: Lobsters are among the best-armored sea creatures. In Canada's Atlantic waters, scientists study their behavior and lifestyle. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Ibis has not produced any offspring for eight years. A larger living space is said to motivate the Asiatic lion. After the freshwater vampire crabs reach sexual maturity, disaster occurs in the tank. (Station info).

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP09

programme.title: GIÁO PHÁI BÁO THÙ - WU LIN: THE SOCIETY
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 2050, nơi tình trạng ô nhiễm và virus tràn lan buộc mọi người phải đeo khẩu trang chỉ để thở, tuy nhiên cuộc sống hàng ngày vẫn tiếp tục như thường lệ. Khi hàng loạt cái chết bí ẩn nổ ra, cảnh sát nghi ngờ kẻ giết người hàng loạt trong khi có tin đồn về một con quỷ đang nổi cơn thịnh nộ. Giờ đây, cảnh sát phải chạy đua để làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn và ngăn chặn các vụ giết người trước khi sự hoảng loạn bao trùm thành phố.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ của mình để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: ĐIỆP VỤ ĐẢO QUỶ - OPERATION BANGKOK
programme.desc: Cựu quân nhân Wu và cảnh sát chìm Ming giải cứu con tin trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Ngay khi nhiệm vụ hoàn thành và họ chuẩn bị rời đi, Wu phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt. Quyết tâm cứu cô, anh ở lại cùng Ming để chiến đấu với bọn côn đồ và giải cứu cô.

programme.title: NA TRA: ĐƯỜNG ĐUA RỰC LỬA - NEZHA
programme.desc: Một cựu tay đua hàng đầu muốn chứng tỏ bản thân trong một cuộc đua nhưng lại vô tình làm tổn thương đồng đội Lily, dẫn đến sự sụp đổ của đội. Khi một nhà vô địch đua xe ảo thiếu kinh nghiệm gia nhập đội và bất ngờ tỏa sáng trong một cuộc đua ngoài đời thực, liệu ba tay đua có thể hợp tác để giành lại vinh quang cho đội của mình?
